reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with orders, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT m.month, m.revenue_eur, p.revenue_eur AS revenue_prev_year_eur
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE m.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with orders, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
), compared AS (
  -- one row per month with orders, with the month a year before
  SELECT m.month, m.revenue_eur,
    (SELECT p.revenue_eur FROM monthly p WHERE p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AS revenue_prev_year_eur
  FROM monthly m
)
SELECT month, revenue_eur, revenue_prev_year_eur
FROM compared
WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

solver.query:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT cur.month, cur.revenue_eur, prev.revenue_eur AS revenue_prev_year_eur
FROM m cur
LEFT JOIN m prev ON prev.month = CAST(cur.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS DATE)
WHERE cur.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
